title: Regression to the Mean
author: Cristy Altamirano
problems: Row 2 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 3 "neighbors do si do once" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 3 are too far apart to do-si-do.
Row 4 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 6 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
choices: Slice: half the counts on the diagonal, half straight back.
A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
